notes.title: The First Community Poll!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey villagers! 🌻
[/h3][p]We’re launching a new way for you to shape [b]Everdream Village[/b] – [u]community polls[/u]!

From now on, we’ll be asking for your opinion on fun (and sometimes silly!) things that might sneak into the game. These decisions are all about you and how you want to play.[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538227/8ecf930a5eee82ee57bf333db91401c18882819b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538227/59f59216d95404151770fcd2ecfc336ce2df1e88.png"][/img][/h3][h3][b]💡 [u]First question:[/u][/b]

Should we hide something behind the waterfall?
✅ [b]Yes[/b], I love hidden mysteries!
 🍃 [b]No[/b], keep it peaceful.[/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45538227/8ecf930a5eee82ee57bf333db91401c18882819b.png"][/img][/h3][p][/p][h3] 🗳 Vote in the comments below, and let us know your thoughts in the comments. 


[i][b]Let’s make Everdream Village Your dream place – together.[/b][/i] 💛✨ [/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3569950/Everdream_Village/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 🌊 Swim with us toward World Ocean Day Festival and help us save marine life! 🐳
notes.content:
[h3] The ocean is cruicial for our entire planet's ecosystems, producing more oxygen and absorbing more carbon than all the forests combined 💧 This event is all about protecting it and its many incredible inhabitants. [/h3]

World Ocean Day Festival is an event by Games For Waves, gaming and streaming community created by Whale and Dolphin Conservation. The goal? To connect gaming industry with real-world conservation efforts. The festival kicks off today and Untold Tales joins in with [b]Everdream Village[/b] and many other titles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/1100d557d97384564b6d41b5b928ce40cf02a4ba.png[/img]

🗓️ From June 5th to 12th, [b]we're pledging 20% of our net profits from selected itemsto Whale and Dolphin Conservation[/b] and you get to purchase our games at [i]deep[/i] discounts. This year, every purchase WDC to protect the ocean and the seas from deadly lost and discarded fishing gear! 🛶🎣🐟
[previewyoutube=7TmAZSZtikA;full][/previewyoutube]
